compiled_state.title: Per-leaf test matrix: 9 explicit tests asserting dso-id label write authorization
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-2: Unit test matrix asserts NO applier leaf writes dso-id except inbound_clean_label and outbound_create — covers all 9 applier leaves, one test per leaf

Add 9 explicit per-leaf test functions to tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_dso_id_label_writers.py — one per applier leaf, named after its leaf so failures localize immediately:
- test_outbound_create_may_write_dso_id_label (authorized)
- test_outbound_update_must_not_write_dso_id_label
- test_outbound_delete_must_not_write_dso_id_label
- test_outbound_probe_must_not_write_dso_id_label
- test_outbound_conflict_must_not_write_dso_id_label
- test_inbound_create_must_not_write_dso_id_label
- test_inbound_update_must_not_write_dso_id_label
- test_inbound_clean_label_may_delete_dso_id_label (authorized — delete only)
- test_inbound_repair_property_must_not_write_dso_id_label (property NOT label)

Each test invokes the leaf with a fixture that would cause dso-id label write if mis-implemented; assertion calls _audit_dso_id_label_writes(leaf_name, returned_mutations) and expects either no raise (authorized) or DsoIdLabelWriteError (unauthorized).

## Test Approach
Given each of 9 applier leaves driven with label-producing-paths fixture; When returned mutations pass through _audit_dso_id_label_writes; Then unauthorized 7 produce no dso-id label mutations (audit passes), authorized 2 confirmed as only emission paths.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint: ruff check tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_dso_id_label_writers.py
- [ ] All 9 per-leaf tests pass
  Verify: pytest tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_dso_id_label_writers.py -k 'must_not_write_dso_id_label or may_write_dso_id_label or may_delete_dso_id_label'
- [ ] inbound_clean_label test confirms delete action permitted
  Verify: pytest tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_dso_id_label_writers.py::test_inbound_clean_label_may_delete_dso_id_label
- [ ] inbound_repair_property test confirms property-field write does NOT produce label mutation
  Verify: pytest tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_dso_id_label_writers.py::test_inbound_repair_property_must_not_write_dso_id_label

## File Impact
- tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_dso_id_label_writers.py — Edit

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)

comments.body: REVISION_CYCLE_1: Add 2 additional tests: (a) test_unauthorized_leaf_non_dso_id_label_write_does_not_raise — invoke unauthorized leaf writing label with payload that does NOT start with 'dso-id-' (e.g., 'custom-tag-foo') → no DsoIdLabelWriteError raised (confirms guard's payload prefix check is a filter, not blanket label prohibition). (b) Add explicit apply()-level integration test per task-2 revision: invoke apply() (NOT _audit directly) with mutation triggering unauthorized dso-id write → DsoIdLabelWriteError propagates out of apply(). Keep direct _audit unit tests as supplementary. test_dso_id_label_writers.py is the SHARED test module (created in task-2, extended here).

comments.body: REVISION_CYCLE_2: Add test for DELETE action coverage. (a) test_unauthorized_leaf_must_not_delete_dso_id_label — unauthorized leaf attempts delete on dso-id label → DsoIdLabelWriteError raised. (b) test_inbound_clean_label_may_delete_dso_id_label remains the sole authorized delete path. Update full matrix: each unauthorized leaf gets {create, update, delete} test coverage; authorized leaves (outbound_create for create, inbound_clean_label for delete) get positive tests for their authorized action.
comments.author: Test

comments.body: FINAL_REMEDIATION: Specify integration test behavioral descriptor — 'apply()-level integration test: invoke apply() with an authorized leaf mutation that writes dso-id label → assert (a) NO DsoIdLabelWriteError raised, (b) resulting Mutation list from apply() contains exactly one entry with target=label + payload starts dso-id- + action=create (for outbound_create) or action=delete (for inbound_clean_label), (c) no other label-touching mutations in the list. Behavioral observable contract: authorized writes produce exactly the expected mutation; no implicit other writes.'
comments.author: Test

comments.body: AC amendment (gap analysis): Per-leaf test matrix must assert FULL mutation-list equality (including ordering), not just guard non-raise. (a) Authorized cells (outbound_create+create, inbound_clean_label+delete) assert returned mutation list equals exactly [expected_mutation] with no piggybacked dso-id-* writes. (b) non-dso-id-payload test asserts guard does NOT raise when leaves write non-dso-id-* labels (e.g., sprint-id-*) — proves payload-prefix check is correctly scoped, not overbroad. Without this, authorized leaf could silently emit extra dso-id-* writes and test passes (implicit_assumption).
